name: @aresrpg/world
description: AresRPG headless world core — THREE reducer atoms behind three input doors (D770a): session_gate (WHICH session is live), spawns_zones (where am I PROVEN to be and what is claimable there), presence (who/what is around me NOW). Composed pure folds inside each door, time/randomness as inputs, effects as exported subscriptions; renderers consume projections and compute nothing. Node-clean: zero DOM/React/three imports.
author: AresRPG's Team
